pixel_description: Side-view photorealistic rover on dirt, white sky. Left to right: front transverse digging drum as spiked disc half-buried in dark soil pile with dust, connected by horizontal arm to chassis at front-wheel axle. Middle spiked grouser wheel under chassis front and larger rear spiked grouser wheel under chassis rear, both touching ground. Central chassis frame as rectangular open-sided metal box; inside left a battery box, inside right a computer box with black wiring. Front-mid tall folding perception mast: 3-stage telescoping rectangular column bolted via triangular base to chassis plus side hydraulic brace cylinder, topped with sensor head with left-pointing bullet camera, center dome, right antenna box with cable loop. CRITICAL PART Rear high-lift mast (lift): drawn as two parallel inclined telescopic hydraulic cylinders plus two parallel structural linkage arms with diagonal cross-brace forming a parallelogram; base pivoted with bolts on rear chassis deck, top pivoted with visible bolts to side plates of hopper; raised to about 2x chassis height. High-lift hopper is trapezoidal sheet bucket tilted nose-down overhanging behind rear axle, pouring continuous dark soil stream into large rectangular collection bin immediately behind rover that touches rover via short bracket. Callouts correctly spelled with no numbers: Folding Perception Mast to mast head, High Lift Hopper to hopper, Chassis Frame to chassis interior, Rear Lift Mast to rear mast cylinder/linkage, Front Digging Drum to drum metal hub/disc, Spiked Grouser Wheel to middle wheel.
